About the Scholarship

CODaS, delivered by the UNITE university network, combines communications engineering with data science for next-generation network technologies. For studies beginning in autumn 2027 the application window runs from 1 December 2026 to 5 January 2027 at 15:00 (GMT+2) — a short, well-defined window.

OpportunityUNITE CODaS – Erasmus Mundus Master in Communications Engineering and Data Science
HostUNITE CODaS Consortium
LocationMunich (multi-country mobility), Germany
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students:
Application Deadline5 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

CODaS, delivered by the UNITE university network, combines communications engineering with data science for next-generation network technologies. For studies beginning in autumn 2027 the application window runs from 1 December 2026 to 5 January 2027 at 15:00 (GMT+2) — a short, well-defined window.

Programme Highlights

  • Communications-plus-data-science hybrid curriculum
  • Five-week window: 1 December 2026 – 5 January 2027 (15:00 GMT+2)
  • Bachelor's requirement of 180 ECTS or three years of full-time study
  • Pathways into 5G/6G research, telecom R&D and data engineering

Who Should Apply

Electrical engineering, telecommunications, computer science and applied mathematics graduates are the core applicants.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit through the CODaS admission page during the December window and check the schedule section for document deadlines. Key deadline information: 5 January 2027 (15:00 GMT+2); application window 1 December 2026 – 5 January 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About UNITE CODaS Consortium

The UNITE CODaS consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Communications Engineering and Data Science through a network of European technical universities.

Official website: https://www.unite-codas-master.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 5 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
